item.description: “In Her Power” will open with a reception from noon to 4 p.m. on March 1 at Mare Island Art Studios, 110 Pintado St., Vallejo.

item.title: Second chances offered at expungement fair
item.description: The event was aimed to help provide residents with an immediate path toward re-entering the workforce. By addressing legal barriers and providing direct connections to industry and labor, the event aimd to ensure that recent job losses do not lead to long-term economic instability or unemployment.
